paragraphs: A Land Rover 300Tdi engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Land Rover already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most 300Tdi owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six 300Tdi-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Land Rover 300Tdi engine?
faqLeft.a: The 300Tdi is Land Rover's 2.5-litre turbocharged four-cylinder diesel engine, produced from 1994 to 1998. It's a mechanically injected diesel engine using a VE fuel injection pump, fitted exclusively to the Defender (L316).

faqLeft.q: Which Land Rover models use the 300Tdi?
faqLeft.a: The 300Tdi was fitted exclusively to the Defender (L316) from 1994 to 1998.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover 300Tdi engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £1,900. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on 300Tdi rebuilds for the Defender, replacing timing belts, bearings, gaskets and seals as standard.

faqLeft.q: Is a 300Tdi the same as a 200Tdi?
faqLeft.a: No — the 300Tdi is the successor to the 200Tdi, with improvements including better low-end torque and reduced turbo lag. They are different engine variants and should be matched correctly.

faqRight.a: The 300Tdi is an interference engine — if the timing belt fails, pistons collide with valves causing catastrophic damage. Other common issues include turbocharger bearing wear, VE fuel injection pump leaks, and head gasket failure.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Land Rover 300Tdi engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Land Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a 300Tdi engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most 300Tdi owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
